title: A three-lane vector target
teaches: A track can drive a vec3 target. The value is a 1..4 lane vector, arity is checked against the host join at load, and each segment carries its own ease.
observe: The first segment (red to green) uses the default linear ease.
The second segment uses out-quad and samples non-dyadic components.
The final key lands all three lanes exactly at 4 b.
